name: Content Calendar Planner
summary: Plans a 4–8 week content calendar mapped to your ICP's questions and buying stages.
description: Generates themes, post ideas and formats across channels you choose, each tied to a persona pain and a funnel stage, so content supports acquisition rather than filling a schedule.
problems: I don't have a marketing team
I don't know what content to publish
I want inbound leads from content

outputs.label: Calendar
outputs.description: Week-by-week items with channel, format, topic and stage.

steps.name: Plan calendar
steps.responsibility: Draft themes and items tied to persona pains.

steps.name: Check coverage
steps.responsibility: Ensure every week and channel has items and every stage is covered.

dependencies.reason: Topics are derived from ICP pains and personas.

criteria.description: All weeks and channels have planned items.
